# Stage 3 — Compare Model Predictions

Each model is evaluated on the **same 2022–2025 holdout seasons**, which were not used to train or tune it. Accuracy shows the share correctly classified; Kappa adjusts for chance agreement; sensitivity and specificity reveal the two types of classification errors. We also calculate **precision** (how many flagged prospects actually get drafted), since scouting teams care about making a useful shortlist. This evaluation is separate from model training.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
dir.create("objects", showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
test_y <- readRDS("objects/test_y.rds")
logit_pred <- readRDS("objects/logit_pred.rds")
knn_pred <- readRDS("objects/knn_pred.rds")
svm_pred <- readRDS("objects/svm_pred.rds")
ann_pred <- readRDS("objects/ann_pred.rds")
tree_pred <- readRDS("objects/tree_pred.rds")
rf_pred <- readRDS("objects/rf_pred.rds")
blend_pred <- readRDS("objects/blend_pred.rds")
base_probs <- readRDS("objects/base_probs.rds")
blend_prob <- readRDS("objects/blend_prob.rds")
```

```{r analysis}
library(caret)

all_predictions <- list(Logistic = logit_pred, KNN = knn_pred,
                        SVM = svm_pred, ANN = ann_pred,
                        DecisionTree = tree_pred, RandomForest = rf_pred,
                        ProbabilityBlend = blend_pred)
# 0/1 labels here are for confusion matrices; the blend used probabilities.
all_confusions <- lapply(all_predictions, function(pred) {
  confusionMatrix(factor(pred, levels = c("Undrafted", "Drafted")),
                  factor(test_y, levels = c("Undrafted", "Drafted")),
                  positive = "Drafted")
})
for (name in names(all_confusions)) {
  cat("\nMODEL:", name, "\n")
  print(all_confusions[[name]])
}

# Pull out the same metrics for an easy side-by-side business comparison.
metrics <- data.frame(
  Model = names(all_confusions),
  Accuracy = sapply(all_confusions, function(cm) unname(cm$overall["Accuracy"])),
  Kappa = sapply(all_confusions, function(cm) unname(cm$overall["Kappa"])),
  Sensitivity = sapply(all_confusions, function(cm) unname(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"])),
  Specificity = sapply(all_confusions, function(cm) unname(cm$byClass["Specificity"])),
  Precision = sapply(all_confusions, function(cm) unname(cm$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]))
)
# Simple baseline: predict the more frequent training class for every prospect.
train_y <- readRDS("objects/train_y.rds")
majority <- names(which.max(table(train_y)))
majority_pred <- factor(rep(majority, length(test_y)), levels = levels(test_y))
majority_cm <- confusionMatrix(majority_pred, test_y, positive = "Drafted")
baseline_metrics <- data.frame(Model = "Always predict training majority",
  Accuracy = as.numeric(majority_cm$overall["Accuracy"]),
  Kappa = as.numeric(majority_cm$overall["Kappa"]),
  Sensitivity = as.numeric(majority_cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
  Specificity = as.numeric(majority_cm$byClass["Specificity"]),
  Precision = as.numeric(majority_cm$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]))
metrics <- rbind(metrics, baseline_metrics)
print(metrics)

```

```{r save-results, include=FALSE}
saveRDS(all_confusions, "objects/all_confusions.rds")
saveRDS(all_predictions, "objects/all_predictions.rds")
saveRDS(metrics, "objects/metrics.rds")
saveRDS(majority_cm, "objects/majority_cm.rds")
```
